params.instruction: Reconstruct the figure: circle with center O (point_03, approx px (224.4,222)) radius ~157.3 px. Verified labels: A at px (66.9,222) left endpoint of diameter AB; B at (381.5,222) right endpoint; C at (210.6,65.8) top of circle; D at (360.7,143.7) upper-right on circle; C' at (237.8,379.1) bottom of circle; P at approx (270.9,222.7) on segment AB between O and B (point_02, label P not bound by CV, verified visually). Segments: AB solid horizontal diameter through O. Solid segment C-P (from C to P). Solid segment C'-O (from C' through O, extending upward to about (224,214)). Dashed segments: C-O, O-D (from center to D, passing near P line?), D-C', C'-P. Verify the dashed/solid assignment and whether O-D is dashed, and confirm that C, O, C' are collinear-ish (C-O-C' is a diameter-like chord, not necessarily exact). Report the final list of labeled points with coordinates and the set of solid vs dashed segments, and any relations (e.g., O is center, A,B on circle, C,D,C' on circle, P on AB). Do not claim right angles unless verified.
